proofBoundary: Machine-readable trtexec parity matrix only. TensorRtExec reports, dry-run output, build-only output, GUI screenshots, and sidecars are not runtime proof or release-close approval.

entries.proofBoundary: ONNX parsing/build report is build-only unless a sample runner records real model execution.
entries.gap: Real model quality still requires model assets, input tensor, output metadata, logs, hashes, and owner review.
entries.nextStep: Cross-link with YoloVision and Classification sample-run evidence records.

entries.proofBoundary: Serialized engine creation is build evidence, not inference proof.
entries.gap: Engine hash and runtime output proof must be collected separately.
entries.nextStep: Record engine SHA256 in real-model candidate manifests.

entries.proofBoundary: Current load-engine path records preflight/readback metadata and may execute bounded one-float-input enqueue/readback. Unmatched output is runtime-output-captured-unverified and is not real-model or package-consumer proof.
entries.gap: Needs model-specific expected output, asset hashes, logs, and owner review before promotion.
entries.nextStep: Use YoloVision or another model-specific runner to promote real-model evidence; keep TensorRtExec generic output as bounded evidence.

entries.proofBoundary: Shape profiles in reports do not prove every dynamic shape ran correctly.
entries.gap: Real profile coverage requires sample runner logs with selected shape and output evidence.
entries.nextStep: Add real YOLO and classification dynamic-shape proof candidates.

entries.proofBoundary: Profile configuration is not output correctness proof.
entries.gap: Needs profile-specific runtime smoke and log hash.
entries.nextStep: Tie YoloVision asset manifests to explicit profile metadata.

entries.proofBoundary: Shape aliases and batch values are normalized/reportable migration aids; they do not prove binding coverage, dynamic profile execution, or output correctness.
entries.gap: Batch/profile behavior still needs model-specific runner logs, selected shape, and output hash evidence.
entries.nextStep: Keep aliases in help/parity artifacts and require sample-run evidence before proof promotion.

entries.proofBoundary: Timing-iteration setter/readback proves builder configuration only; it does not prove tactic quality, benchmark performance, model correctness, or package-consumer runtime.
entries.gap: TRT10/11 retain the legacy --minTiming option as parse-only; compatible-host build logs are still needed for applied readback evidence.
entries.nextStep: Collect versioned TRT8/10/11 build logs with TrtexecTiming ReadbackMatch=True while keeping runtime proof separate.

entries.proofBoundary: Task-specific shape profiles are build/report evidence only; real-model-runtime requires YoloVision run log, output JSON, hashes, and owner review.
entries.gap: Owner still needs to backfill real assets, TensorRtExec report hashes, YoloVision logs, and sample-run evidence.
entries.nextStep: Validate owner backfill pack before promoting any real-model-runtime candidate.

entries.proofBoundary: The switch can be represented; GPU/model support must be proven by smoke.
entries.gap: No owner host FP16 result is bundled.
entries.nextStep: Record FP16 host/model runs in compatible-host proof packs.

entries.proofBoundary: INT8 and calibration cache paths are CLI/GUI/report fields only; calibrator ownership and cache validity are not promoted by this application matrix.
entries.gap: Calibrator callback ownership, calibration dataset provenance, cache hash, and model-specific INT8 accuracy evidence still need a stricter bridge.
entries.nextStep: Create INT8/calibration owner field guide and native ownership design before implementation.

entries.proofBoundary: FP8/best precision shortcuts, refit dumps, weight-streaming intent, and debug tensor names are CLI/GUI/report fields only; they do not prove precision support, refit lifecycle, weight streaming execution, or debug tensor runtime output.
entries.gap: Needs TensorRT-line-specific capability checks, model-specific debug tensor ownership, runtime artifact hashes, and owner-reviewed logs before promotion.
entries.nextStep: Keep as parse/report-only while deferred boundary work promotes safe read-only capability probes and model-specific runtime proofs.

entries.proofBoundary: Memory pool set/get readback proves builder-config acceptance only; it is not runtime output, model accuracy, or package-consumer proof.
entries.gap: A compatible-host build log is still required for owner evidence; dry-run and load-engine intentionally remain parse-only.
entries.nextStep: Capture TrtexecMemoryPool RequestedBytes/ReadbackBytes/ReadbackMatch in a compatible-host build record without promoting runtime proof.

entries.proofBoundary: Timing cache import/export lifecycle proof and SHA256 metadata are build-cache evidence only; they are not model accuracy, runtime execution, real-model-runtime, or package-consumer-runtime proof.
entries.gap: Owner still needs to retain the input/output cache files and hashes alongside a real model build record; load-engine and dry-run modes intentionally do not apply cache lifecycle.
entries.nextStep: Use TimingCacheArtifact input/output paths, byte counts, and SHA256 in owner build evidence while keeping runtime proof separate.

entries.proofBoundary: GUI/CLI field parity proves option surface alignment only; command preview, GUI screenshots, dry-runs, and reports are not runtime proof.
entries.gap: Checklist-backed parity still needs real model runner evidence and package-consumer validators for proof promotion.
entries.nextStep: Keep GUI/CLI parity in the release checklist while owner evidence templates collect real logs and hashes.

entries.proofBoundary: Plugin library paths, trtexec-compatible aliases, and copied inventory metadata do not prove plugin library load/register/deregister.
entries.gap: Register/deregister/load library and serialized plugin ownership remain deferred due to ownership risk.
entries.nextStep: Use parsed plugin paths and copied Plugin Inventory only as diagnostics; promote load/register only after an explicit safe ownership design and smoke proof.

entries.proofBoundary: Profiling artifacts are diagnostics unless a real enqueue run and log prove runtime execution.
entries.gap: Real model profile output still needs model-specific sample proof.
entries.nextStep: Add profile artifact schema to real-model candidate manifests.

entries.proofBoundary: Wait/idle controls are accepted and reported for command parity; they do not prove official benchmark scheduler semantics or runtime performance.
entries.gap: Needs real benchmark execution logs and host metadata before these controls can support performance claims.
entries.nextStep: Retain parse/report-only status until package-consumer runtime benchmark evidence is owner-supplied.

entries.proofBoundary: Real build/load-engine paths copy TensorRtEngineInspector layer text and can export it; dry-run/dependency-unavailable paths remain report-only. Layer info is diagnostic metadata, not output correctness proof.
entries.gap: External ONNX layer semantics require model-specific documentation.
entries.nextStep: Cross-check EngineInspector read-only APIs in future diagnostics.

entries.proofBoundary: Report aliases only choose JSON/Markdown output paths; reports remain build/report evidence and cannot promote runtime proof.
entries.gap: No gap for CLI alias parsing; proof promotion still needs real model runner logs and package-consumer-runtime records.
entries.nextStep: Keep --exportReport as the canonical normalized command while accepting --report in owner-facing handoff snippets.

entries.proofBoundary: Verbose logs are supporting evidence only; logs need SHA256 and owner review.
entries.gap: No bundled owner-reviewed compatible-host log.
entries.nextStep: Require stdout/stderr summaries and log hashes in proof inputs.

entries.proofBoundary: YoloVision runtime reports copy TensorRtEngineBindingReport metadata and semantic output roles without native pointers; synthetic/bounded output remains non-proof and external ONNX correctness still requires real model evidence.
entries.gap: Real model input/output tensor roles, hashes, and expected evidence lines must be owner-filled.
entries.nextStep: Align bindingMetadata with YoloVision task/output contracts and owner-filled model, input, engine, output, log, and review hashes.

entries.proofBoundary: Only clean external package consumer smoke validated as package-consumer-runtime can promote release proof.
entries.gap: Owner must provide public package source, clean consumer, real host metadata, exitCode=0, and matching hashes.
entries.nextStep: Collect real owner input and run strict validators after public package availability.
